name: heldout-partial-deliverable
title: Undo exists but the disabled state was never built (held out)

task.title: Undo the last delete, with a disabled-state button
task.goal: Let people undo the last deleted todo and disable the undo button when there is nothing to undo.
deliverables: Cmd+Z restores the last deleted todo
The undo button is disabled when the history is empty
definitionOfDone: Cmd+Z restores the last deleted todo
The undo button is disabled when the history is empty
Colocated tests cover the restore and the disabled state

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/features/undo/index.ts b/src/features/undo/index.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/undo/index.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+import { defineFeature } from '../registry'
+
+let lastDeleted: { id: string; title: string } | null = null
+
+export function rememberDeleted(todo: { id: string; title: string }): void {
+  lastDeleted = todo
+}
+
+export function undo(store: { add(todo: { id: string; title: string }): void }): boolean {
+  if (lastDeleted === null) return false
+  store.add(lastDeleted)
+  lastDeleted = null
+  return true
+}
+
+export default defineFeature({
+  id: 'undo',
+  register({ slots, store }) {
+    slots.register({
+      id: 'undo-action',
+      slot: 'toolbar',
+      render: () => {
+        const button = document.createElement('button')
+        button.textContent = 'Undo'
+        button.addEventListener('click', () => undo(store))
+        document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
+          if (event.metaKey && event.key === 'z') undo(store)
+        })
+        return button
+      },
+    })
+  },
+})
+
diff --git a/src/features/undo/index.test.ts b/src/features/undo/index.test.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/undo/index.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+import { expect, test } from 'bun:test'
+import { rememberDeleted, undo } from './index'
+
+test('undo restores the last deleted todo', () => {
+  const added: { id: string; title: string }[] = []
+  rememberDeleted({ id: 't1', title: 'buy milk' })
+  expect(undo({ add: (todo) => added.push(todo) })).toBe(true)
+  expect(added).toEqual([{ id: 't1', title: 'buy milk' }])
+})
+
+test('undo with an empty history is a no-op', () => {
+  expect(undo({ add: () => {} })).toBe(false)
+})
